note: Solar installed capacity (GW). Each country takes whichever source's own latest point is more recent: the monthly file (DC nameplate rating, ~monthly cadence, 25 countries) or the yearly file's own Capacity (GW) column (one point a year, wider coverage). A country's entry is either "granularity": "monthly" with a `series` of {year, month, gw} points, or "granularity": "annual" with an `annualSeries` of {year, gw} points - never both.
